key_insight: Structured, permissioned access to application state can turn chat into a workspace-wide control layer while preserving user control.
engineering_relevance: AI-enabled interfaces should expose state and capabilities through structured APIs, with a separate control-plane boundary for agents that can modify their own settings.
method: Define a meta-access ladder from feature tutoring and settings access to retrieval, confirmed changes, and orchestration.
Demonstrate Meta Chat using bounded context from summaries, settings, and relevant messages, with linked workspace references.
Support confirmed, reversible changes, browsable tutorials, and persona recommendations that users initiate.
evidence_signal: The abstract grounds the proposal in the Meta Chat prototype but reports no quantitative evaluation or comparative results.
watch_item: Workspace access introduces privacy, grounding, and prompt-injection risks, requiring scoped permissions and safeguards around state changes.
paper_title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
